title: Unit tests with JUnit, written test-first: arrange, act, assert, assertThrows

objectives.text: Write a failing JUnit test before the code, then make it pass
Structure a test as arrange, act and assert with assertEquals and assertTrue
Test that code throws the expected exception with assertThrows
